title: Gazettal of rules: cryptoassets standard and other updates
summary: HKMA's circular 'Gazettal of rules: cryptoassets standard and other updates,' dated 11 July 2025, indicates that rules relating to HKMA's 'cryptoassets standard' have been published in the Gazette, together with other, unspecified updates. Gazettal is the formal publication step through which subsidiary rules made under an ordinance take, or move toward, legal effect in Hong Kong. HKMA's document repository (brdr.hkma.gov.hk) returned a server error (HTTP 503) on every attempt to retrieve this document during this review, so the circular's intended recipients, which specific rules were gazetted, their commencement date, and the substance of the 'other updates' referenced in the title are not confirmed against primary source text; this summary is limited to what the circular's own published title states.
why_it_matters: Gazettal is how Hong Kong formally publishes new or amended subsidiary legislation, so this circular marks a concrete step toward legal force for the rules named in its title. For a newcomer, it is a sign this rulemaking has moved toward formal legal effect, even though the rules' substance and intended audience are not confirmed here.
